title: session.bound
description: The save slot now paired with the world: gen1-bridge tells the client (G→M), which records it on the server (C→S).

switched.description: How the hidden game reached the slot: none (it was already on it: held messages may go on), title (moved at the title screen), saved (the running game was saved into its own slot first, then returned to the title), moved (a never-saved New Game moved into the empty slot as it is). Absent: unknown (treat as a switch).

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
